title: Closely Review (2026)
intro: Closely is a LinkedIn + email outbound automation platform with enrichment, AI agents, and white-label options. This review scores it with CRM methodology criteria — strong on outbound automation, weaker as a pipeline CRM.
summary: Closely fits outbound teams and agencies automating LinkedIn+email with clear list pricing. Keep a CRM for deals. Scores reflect first-party research, not hands-on testing.
verdict: Closely is a strong outbound automation tool with transparent pricing and weak CRM-pipeline fit. Review based on first-party research, not hands-on testing.

criterionAssessments.rationale: Marketing emphasizes accessible outbound automation and smart inbox; LinkedIn-seat model is easy to understand.
Closely is an engagement/automation layer with CRM sync — not a deal pipeline CRM.
LinkedIn automation, email campaigns, multichannel conditional sequences are the product core.
Unlimited email accounts per sender model, OAuth Gmail/Outlook, smart inbox documented.
Advanced analytics & reports listed on pricing comparison.
White-label branding/domain customization is a differentiator, especially for agencies.
Salesforce, HubSpot, Pipedrive, GoHighLevel integrations prominently documented.
LinkedIn account warmup/proxies and sender ops require ongoing attention.
Seat ladder to Essential/Custom; $999 unlimited white-label path for agencies.
Clear published Starter–Essential pricing from $29/mo annual is competitive for LinkedIn+email automation.

faq.question: How much does Closely cost?
faq.answer: Official pricing (Aug 2026): Starter $49 monthly or $29/mo annually; Growth $127/$87; Essential $205/$145. Custom plans available. Confirm on closelyhq.com/pricing.

faq.question: Is Closely a CRM?
faq.answer: No. Closely automates LinkedIn/email outbound and syncs with CRMs such as Salesforce, HubSpot, and Pipedrive.

faq.question: Is this a hands-on SoftwareGlimpse lab review?
faq.answer: No. Approved from first-party Closely research without recorded hands-on testing.

sections.heading: What Closely is
sections.body: Closely is a LinkedIn and email outbound automation platform with enrichment, AI agents, and optional white-label packaging.

sections.heading: Pricing and plans
sections.body: Starter, Growth, and Essential are publicly priced with annual discounts; Custom covers larger/agency needs including a documented $999/mo unlimited white-label option in FAQ.

sections.heading: Core capabilities
sections.body: Documented pillars include LinkedIn automation, email/multichannel campaigns, enrichment, AI agents, analytics, CRM integrations, and white-label.

sections.heading: Who it’s for
sections.body: Best for outbound teams and agencies automating LinkedIn+email. Weak as a CRM replacement.
